node.title: HGE4 Kummer midpoint trace-power gate
node.statement: For every primitive retained near-third pencil, if u,v are the leading reciprocal coefficients and x=v/u, then x lies in mu_m minus {+1,-1} and the midpoint Kummer scalar is kappa=-(1+x)^2/(8x). Primitivity makes kappa an m-th power in F_p, so the trace tau=x+x^(-1) satisfies C_m(tau)=2 and (-(tau+2)/8)^((p-1)/m)=1. There are exactly (m-2)/2 trace candidates before this power test. Every passing x is a square; if (p-1)/m is odd, only m/4-1 traces remain. This is a candidate gate, not an orbit bound.
